lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Wednesday's Board of County Commissioners meeting, where the BOCC will ratify a policy change at Pinion Park dropping income eligibility to 80% AMI — a quiet but consequential shift that determines who can actually get into deed-restricted housing in this valley. Also Wednesday, the Ecology Commission takes up a draft ordinance that would ban gas-powered leaf blowers in Town limits by 2028 and all covered equipment by 2030. On the community side, Wilkinson Public Library opens its new Youth Area Wednesday, and the Mountain Towns 2030 climate network has sessions both Wednesday and Thursday.
